name: APCO Plastics
old_description: After seeing this device online, our team of plastics experts begun to duplicate and produce for local health care.
about:
APCO Plastics operates from Greenville, South Carolina, and was founded in 1996. With over 30 years in the plastics trade, the company provides custom fabrication and CNC routing services to business and personal clients. No founders or ownership structure are disclosed publicly.

The shop’s capabilities include custom fabrication, CNC routing, project design, bending, polishing, and custom light lenses. Its product portfolio spans custom-made turntable dust covers, acrylic lenses, windshields, intubation shields produced for local healthcare during the pandemic, and custom privacy shields. Facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not published.

APCO serves healthcare providers, retail businesses, automotive and motorcycle owners, lighting manufacturers, and hobbyists restoring vintage turntables. Concrete examples from the company’s site include retail displays, replacement windshields, and dust covers for vintage turntables, alongside the COVID-era intubation shields for local health care.

The company highlights a personalized approach, assisting customers with design and material selection, and points to its self-described largest and most loyal customer base in the Upstate as evidence of repeat business. Product excellence and a broad variety of products and services are stated priorities.
